seoDescription: Osnova is a full-stack template for building web applications quickly with Python and React
tagline: A full-stack template for building web applications quickly with Python and React.
capabilitiesNote: Capabilities are switched on in the configuration and reach the interface through bootstrap, without rewriting the architecture.
allDisabled: All capabilities are off, so the app works as a public website. Turn on the flags you need in .env and restart the backend.

profiles.minimal: Minimal infrastructure: websites, information apps and small services.
profiles.standard: Production profile: users, admin panel, background tasks, storage.
profiles.scalable: Horizontal scaling: load balancing, several instances, CDN.
